name: Chronological makes Discordance instant every 20 sec (#2189)
contract: Chronological 592008 is a permanent passive (duration index 21 = -1) whose single effect is aura 23 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL) with Amplitude 20000 on 542728, implicit target 1. This is not a proc and needs no spell_proc row: AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic marks the effect periodic and the tick dispatcher calls AuraEffect::HandlePeriodicTriggerSpellAuraTick, so every 20 s the passive casts 542728 on its holder with no script. 542728 lasts 10000 ms (duration index 1) and its effect 0 is aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 = SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME, BasePoints -101 = -100%) class-masked to Discordance's SpellFamilyFlags word0 33554432, and aura 107/108 are native in AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod. Discordance 503875 has CastingTimeIndex 16 = 1500 ms, so the tooltip "Every 20 sec, your next Discordance within 10 seconds is instant cast" means SpellInfo::CalcCastTime must fall from a non-zero value to 0 once the buff lands. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works; it changes nothing.

steps.label: No Chronological buff in the first tick period
Discordance still has a real cast time
Wait past the passive's 20 s period
The passive's periodic tick casts Chronological on its holder
Discordance is instant while the buff is up
